headline: Bitcoin Options Bid the 75k Put Over the 92k Call Into the Oct. 14 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew printed 27.71 into the Oct. 14 expiry, with the 75k put bid against the 92k call, so listed money is paying for a drop under spot. Bitcoin is up 0.71% and changing hands near 83k, so the hedge is insurance on a tape that is still higher, not a rush out of the market. Silver fell 1.1% to 59.48 and gold slipped 0.27% to 4,179, leaving the protection bid in crypto options rather than in the metals.
author: jordan
